prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing.
Create a FINISHED seamlessly CONNECTED GOOGLE PLAY STORE SCREENSHOT CAMPAIGN as ONE single wide panoramic image that will be cut into FOUR equal adjacent portrait images. Overall aspect ratio EXACTLY 9:4 (2.25:1), target 4320x1920 or 3456x1536. Each quarter is a standalone 9:16 Play Store artwork. No gutters, borders, dividers or contact-sheet appearance. One uninterrupted designed canvas.
Brand Lucro Caseiro, Brazilian microbusiness management app. Premium human, warm, confident store-listing campaign. Deep wine #4B2233 main background, dusty rose #B15C72, cream #FFF8EF, small lime accents #DCE66C matching reference app. Beautiful large bold editorial serif headlines, clean sans serif captions, high contrast, amazing art direction. Sophisticated photo plus product-interface collage.
COMPOSITION across four equal-width panels:
PANEL 1 (x=0-25%): Small wordmark "Lucro Caseiro" at top. Huge headline EXACT "Seu talento.\nSeu negócio." Below, short caption "Organize sua rotina com o Lucro Caseiro." A beautiful natural editorial photograph of a fictional Brazilian woman entrepreneur age about 30, medium brown skin, dark curly shoulder-length hair, simple ivory shirt and dusty rose apron, confident warm smile looking at viewer, from waist up. She is holding a small kraft pastry box with pink ribbon at waist, on a cream curved tabletop. Authentic friendly expression and skin texture, not plastic or exaggerated. Her head and face must be fully within first panel, her right arm and the table may extend a little across seam into second panel. She fills lower ~65%, not a tiny inset. No fake review or quote.
PANEL 2 (25-50%): Small category "PRECIFICAÇÃO". Huge headline EXACT "Seu preço,\ncom clareza." Supporting text "Custos, margem e lucro em um só cálculo." A large front-facing Android phone presenting Image 1 (pricing screenshot), faithfully preserving actual screen design and readable key amounts R$30,49, R$7,39 and 24%. Phone starts around y=30% and bleeds to bottom, device nearly fills panel width with slim wine bezel. Screenshot not redesigned, no invented cards.
PANEL 3 (50-75%): Small category "CATÁLOGO DIGITAL". Huge headline EXACT "Sua vitrine,\npronta para vender." Supporting text "Compartilhe produtos e serviços com seus clientes." Large Android phone presenting Image 2 (catalog screenshot), same scale and y alignment as panel 2, slightly rotated -3 degrees, preserve actual UI content and artwork faithfully.
PANEL 4 (75-100%): Small category "FINANCEIRO". Huge headline EXACT "Seu dinheiro,\nbem organizado." Supporting text "Acompanhe entradas, despesas e resultados." Large Android phone presenting Image 3 (finance screenshot) preserve all values EXACTLY: lucro R$31,30, entradas R$1.077,00, saídas R$1.045,70. Do not invent improved numbers. Same phone scale.
CONNECTED VISUAL SYSTEM: A broad continuous blush satin ribbon sweeps across the whole panorama BEHIND woman and phones from y=65% at left through y=60% at first seam, y=73% at second seam, y=65% at third seam and y=70% at right. One sweeping cream curved tabletop spans the whole bottom edge. Subtle single thin rose arc continues across multiple panels, maintaining continuity. Tiny crafted rose / lime spark accents, maximum three total, behind subjects. Background remains burgundy through all seams with subtle warm variation. No separate panel frames.
CUT SAFETY: each panel's headlines and caption must fit INSIDE its own quarter with 6% panel-width inner margin on each side, no words or phones cut by seams. Phones stay entirely within their own quarter except bottom bleed. Only background ribbon/table and woman's arm connect across seams. Copy around top 25-28% in each panel. Headline total 2-3 lines, very readable. Do not add extra text beyond provided words; tiny "Telas com dados ilustrativos" inside last panel bottom margin if space.
High-end finished marketing artwork, not a wireframe or design board. Portrait person must be anatomically plausible, correct hands. No Play Store badge, no ratings, no download CTA, no logo invented. Exact Portuguese spelling and accents. Source screenshot references are ACTUAL app captures; faithfully use their contents. Return ONE panoramic image spanning FOUR connected equal panels, no margin around entire panorama.
